name: retrieve_and_halve_value
description: Calls another routine to obtain a 16-bit value and returns that value shifted right by one bit, which halves it.

name: lookup_reciprocal_from_squared_length
description: Sums the squares of three 16-bit components and derives a table index from that total, using different shift amounts for several magnitude ranges. It returns the table entry at that index, shifted right to scale it.

name: lookup_table_value_by_magnitude
description: Takes one 32-bit input and selects among several index-building schemes according to its magnitude. It returns the table entry it finds, shifted right to scale it.

name: lookup_table_value_three_ranges
description: Selects one of three index-building schemes for a 32-bit input depending on its magnitude, then returns a shifted table entry. Two of the branches build the index by swapping the halves of the input.

name: fetch_halved_table_entry
description: Uses the input word, shifted right by two, as an index into a global table and returns the stored entry shifted right by one bit.

name: fetch_table_word_shift_four
description: Uses the input word, shifted right by four, as an index into a global table and returns the word stored there.

name: lookup_table_entry_rearranged_index
description: Rearranges the halves of a 32-bit input and combines them with its low bits to form a table index. It returns the table entry at that index shifted right by three.

name: lookup_table_entry_wide_index
description: Swaps the halves of a 32-bit input and shifts the result left by six to build a table index. It returns the table entry at that index shifted right by five.

name: compute_strided_dot_product_pair
description: Computes two dot products between a three-element vector held in registers and words read from memory at a stride of three. Each result is doubled and both are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

name: compute_consecutive_dot_product_pair
description: Computes two dot products between a three-element register vector and two consecutive three-word blocks in memory. Each result is doubled and both are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

name: build_rotation_matrix_two_angles
description: Looks up sine-like and cosine-like table values for two angle inputs, negating each value whose sign bit is set, and writes a 3x3 matrix with products at fixed offsets. The eighth word is cleared to zero.

name: build_matrix_table_base_angles
description: Looks up four table values from a base address held in a register, two from register angles and two from stack arguments, negating those with the sign bit set. It writes a 3x3 matrix with products at fixed offsets and clears the eighth word.

name: build_matrix_one_direct_value
description: Looks up three table values from register and stack angles, negating two that have the sign bit set. It writes a 3x3 matrix in memory with one value taken directly from a register and clears the eighth word.

name: write_matrix_one_lookup_direct
description: Looks up one table value, negates it if its sign bit is set, and writes a 3x3 matrix in memory. Two other entries come directly from register values, and the eighth word is cleared.

name: build_rotation_matrix_one_lookup
description: Looks up one table value and combines it with two direct register values to write a 3x3 matrix in memory. Products and negations are placed at fixed offsets and the eighth word is cleared.

name: build_negated_matrix_two_angles
description: Looks up sine-like and cosine-like table values for two angle inputs, applying sign corrections, and writes a 3x3 matrix with several terms negated. The sixth word is cleared to zero.

name: build_negated_matrix_stack_angles
description: Looks up table values for two angle arguments taken from the stack and one from a register, applying sign corrections. It writes a 3x3 matrix with several terms negated and the sixth word cleared.

name: build_negated_matrix_partial_inputs
description: Combines one table lookup with register and stack values to write a 3x3 matrix in memory. Several terms are negated and the sixth word is cleared to zero.

name: build_negated_matrix_direct_inputs
description: Uses one table lookup and direct register values to write a 3x3 matrix in memory. Several terms are negated and the sixth word is cleared to zero.

name: build_inverse_rotation_matrix
description: Uses a table lookup and register inputs to write a 3x3 matrix in memory, with several terms negated. The sixth word is cleared to zero.

name: compute_sine_cosine_products
description: Looks up two sine-like table values from two angle inputs, offsetting one angle to obtain a cosine-like value, and negates any value whose sign bit is set. Returns a 64-bit result built from products of these values with sign inversions and shifts.

name: compute_table_scaled_product_pair
description: Uses a table lookup scaled by one register and two sign-corrected table values from other register inputs to form products. The products are returned packed into a 64-bit result with a sign inversion in the high part.

name: compute_register_table_product_pair
description: Combines a register value with a sign-corrected table value and a second product to build a 64-bit result. The high and low parts are formed with sign inversion and shifts.

name: compute_register_product_with_table
description: Multiplies two register inputs and multiplies one of them by a sign-corrected table value. Both products are packed into a 64-bit return value.

name: compute_vector_component
description: Computes a product of two register inputs and a product involving a table lookup. The two products are combined into a 64-bit return value with shifts and sign inversions.

name: interpolate_point_within_bounds
description: Steps a fixed-point interpolation between two coordinate pairs, halving the increments on each iteration and comparing against limits of 319 and 168. It returns the resulting pair packed into a 64-bit value once a threshold is reached.

name: interpolate_point_toward_limit
description: Repeats a fixed-point interpolation step on a coordinate pair, halving the increments and comparing against limits of 168 and a larger bound. It returns the resulting pair packed into a 64-bit value.

name: accumulate_fixed_point_pair
description: Adds halved increments to two fixed-point accumulators on each iteration, stopping when the step counter drops below 64. Both values are shifted down and returned packed into a 64-bit result.

name: interpolate_point_upper_bound
description: Steps a fixed-point interpolation between two coordinate pairs, halving increments and comparing against limits of 169 and a larger bound. It returns the resulting pair packed into a 64-bit value.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Decompiles to nothing but a return, so no behaviour can be recovered from this pseudo-code.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Decompiles to nothing but a return, so no behaviour can be recovered from this pseudo-code.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Decompiles to nothing but a return, so no behaviour can be recovered from this pseudo-code.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Decompiles to nothing but a return, so no behaviour can be recovered from this pseudo-code.

name: rotate_two_vector_pairs
description: Looks up sine-like and cosine-like table values for an angle, then rotates corresponding components of two three-element vectors in place. Each updated word is doubled and shifted down.

name: rotate_vector_pairs_from_table
description: Looks up sine-like and cosine-like values from a table at a base address in a register, then rotates corresponding components of two three-element vectors in place. Each updated word is doubled and shifted down.

name: rotate_vector_pairs_direct_coefficients
description: Rotates corresponding components of two three-element vectors in place, using one coefficient taken directly from a register and one looked up in a table. Each updated word is doubled and shifted down.

name: insert_into_search_tree
description: Walks a binary search tree from its root, comparing stored keys with the supplied key, and links a new node at the first empty child position. The new node receives the key and both child pointers are cleared.

name: insert_into_tree_from_node
description: Inserts a node with a supplied key into a binary search tree, starting the walk from a node passed in an address register. The new node is linked under the first empty child and its child pointers are cleared.

name: initialise_tree_list_head
description: Sets up a list head node with zeroed link fields and fixed constant values. It then points global pointers at the node and sets several global counters and constants.

name: reset_list_head_node
description: Clears a global value and re-initializes the first node of a linked list to zeroed links and the same fixed constants. It then resets the related global pointers and counters.

name: set_global_pointers_to_stack
description: Points three global pointer variables at the same local stack buffer, which is a large array of undefined bytes. It does nothing else.

name: dispatch_handlers_in_node_list
description: Walks a linked list of nodes by following each node's next pointer. For each node it calls a handler selected by a 16-bit offset stored in that node, looping until the list ends.

name: dispatch_handlers_from_list_head
description: Walks a linked list of nodes starting from a global list head, calling for each node a handler chosen by a 16-bit offset stored in that node. The walk repeats until the list is exhausted.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains nothing but a return, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: transform_three_vectors_by_matrix
description: When a cached state byte differs from a global value, it multiplies three three-element vectors by the 3x3 matrix held in the structure. It writes nine results at fixed offsets and then records the new state byte.

name: accumulate_scaled_matrix_product
description: Shifts a three-component input right until it fits, then multiplies it by a 3x3 matrix in memory. The scaled results are added with carry into three 64-bit accumulators in the structure.

name: accumulate_scaled_vector_with_params
description: Shifts a three-component value right by a computed amount, multiplies it by a 3x3 matrix in memory, and adds the scaled results to three 64-bit values passed as parameters. The totals are stored back into the structure.

name: shift_add_vector_into_accumulators
description: Shifts three register inputs right by a variable amount and adds them to parameters, storing each sum and its carry into the structure. The state byte is updated afterwards.

name: update_accumulators_with_cache
description: Returns a cached 64-bit value when a state byte matches. Otherwise it recalculates the value from a 3x3 matrix product, updates three accumulators with carry, and records the new state.

name: update_accumulators_cached_variant
description: Returns a cached 64-bit value when a caller-supplied state byte matches the stored one. Otherwise it recalculates the matrix product, updates three accumulators with carry, and records the new state.

name: return_cached_pair_value
description: Returns the 64-bit value stored at a fixed offset in the structure pointed to by an address register, without changing anything.

name: copy_accumulators_from_base
description: Copies six 32-bit words from one group of structure fields into another group and then records the current state byte.

name: compute_relative_offset_pair
description: Returns the differences between two stored 32-bit field pairs when their flag bytes match. When they do not match, it falls back to another routine and subtracts its cached result, returning both differences packed into 64 bits.

name: compute_relative_offset_fallback
description: Returns the differences between two stored 32-bit field pairs when a flag byte matches. Otherwise it calls another routine and subtracts its cached result from the pair.

name: negate_two_long_fields
description: Reads two 32-bit fields from the structure in an address register, negates both, and returns them packed into one 64-bit value.

name: store_scaled_value_and_call
description: Shifts a 16-bit field left by a count, doubles the result into a frame slot, and stores the high byte of another field in a second slot. It then calls another routine.

name: store_high_byte_and_call
description: Extracts the high byte of a 16-bit field in one structure, stores it in a frame slot, and calls another routine.

name: calculate_shift_mask_from_difference
description: Builds a single-bit byte by shifting one by the difference between a register value and a structure field, clamping it to a positive value when the high bit is set. It stores the byte and two sentinel words in the structure.

name: transform_state_against_thresholds
description: Transforms a structure's three-component state with a shift and table-indexed scaling, then compares the result against two per-entry thresholds. When a threshold condition holds it updates flags and output words and writes one byte into a global output buffer.

name: update_entry_threshold_state
description: Compares a per-entry value with a threshold from a second structure. Below the threshold it writes a clamped shift-derived byte and sentinel words, otherwise it continues into a longer transform.

name: transform_entry_and_set_sentinels
description: Multiplies a three-component state by a 3x3 matrix in memory after a shift. It writes the results and sentinel words into an entry depending on a threshold test and a flag, calling other routines along the way.

name: transform_struct_block_emit_marker
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix from memory by a three-vector block stored in a structure, writing nine doubled and shifted results into frame storage. It then calls two routines and appends a marker byte when a pending flag is set.

name: transform_vectors_and_emit_marker
description: Optionally moves to a second matrix entry, then multiplies a 3x3 matrix by a three-vector block into frame storage. It calls routines and appends a marker byte to the output buffer when a pending flag is set.

name: emit_pending_marker
description: Calls routines and, when a pending flag is set, appends one marker byte to a global output buffer and clears the flag.

name: emit_marker_if_flagged
description: Calls routines and checks a global flag. If the flag is set, it stores a constant marker byte in the output buffer, advances the buffer pointer and clears the flag.

name: emit_pending_marker_early_exit
description: Calls routines and, when a pending flag is set, appends a marker byte to the output buffer and returns early. Otherwise it simply returns.

name: transform_entry_with_sentinel_reset
description: Writes sentinel words into two entry fields, then either copies a nine-word block or multiplies a 3x3 matrix by a stored vector block into frame storage. It calls other routines as it proceeds.

name: normalize_triple_and_transform_matrix
description: Finds a right-shift count that brings three 32-bit values into a 16-bit range, shifts them and negates them. It multiplies them by two 3x3 matrices held in the frame and stores the results there.

name: compute_clamped_margin_value
description: Shifts a 16-bit structure field left by a count, then compares two frame values against the shifted amount and their sum. It returns a clamped margin, which is zero when the tests fail.

name: clear_strided_word_block
description: Zeroes words in a buffer at a fixed stride, with the number of rows derived from a 16-bit field shifted right by six. The loop is unrolled in blocks of ten rows.

name: clear_frame_fields_and_block
description: Zeroes five fixed fields in a frame structure, then zeroes a strided block of words. The number of rows is derived from a 16-bit input shifted right by six.

name: fill_stack_words_with_pattern
description: Fills a run of words in the stack frame with a constant pattern. The count is a structure field halved and reduced by three, and nothing is written when the count is negative.

name: emit_record_if_in_bounds
description: Tests two coordinates against limits of 319 and 167 and returns early if either is outside. Otherwise it builds a flag word and fills an output record from frame values, calling other routines.

name: emit_bounded_record_variant
description: Returns early when a coordinate is outside its limit, then checks a second coordinate against 167. It builds a flag word and emits an output record, calling routines to fetch table entries.

name: emit_fixed_record_for_sum
description: Returns early when a summed coordinate is zero or overflows. Otherwise it writes a fixed-layout record of forty-one words, with table-based fields and constant values.

name: emit_fixed_record_table_entries
description: Writes a fixed-layout record of constant values into the output buffer. It fills two fields by allocating or looking up entries in a global table and advances the allocation counter.

name: emit_fixed_record_shared_lookup
description: Writes a fixed-layout record of constant values and fills two fields by looking up or allocating entries in a shared global table. It calls another routine to prepare the output pointer.

name: emit_scaled_record_table_entry
description: Allocates a global table entry and stores its value in the record. It then divides a frame value by a size from another routine and writes the scaled results into the output record.

name: emit_divided_record_with_lookup
description: Stores a byte and a word into a table, then derives a ratio by signed division of a frame value by a size returned from another routine. The results are written into the output record.

name: write_scaled_point_record
description: Stores a value in the record, computes two signed ratios by division against a size from another routine, and writes scaled x and y pairs into several fixed slots of the output record.

name: emit_scaled_point_record_alt
description: Stores a value and a table entry in the record, computes two signed ratios by division, and writes the resulting pair into several output slots.

name: emit_clipped_sprite_record
description: Computes a position and, if it lies within limits of 320 and 168, writes a six-word record into the output buffer. A flag bit selects the record code, and the remaining fields are filled from table entries.

name: emit_clipped_sprite_record_alt
description: Computes a position and writes a six-word record when it lies within limits of 320 and 168. A flag bit selects the record code, and table entries fill the other fields.

name: emit_flagged_record_with_table
description: Writes a six-word record whose code is chosen by a flag bit, then fills two more fields by allocating or looking up entries in the global table.

name: emit_flagged_record_shared_table
description: Writes a six-word record whose code depends on a flag bit and fills two further fields from a shared global table of entries.

name: write_record_table_entry_pair
description: Stores a counter-based table entry in the first record field and looks up or allocates a second table entry for another field. Both values are written into the record.

name: store_table_entry_and_word
description: Writes a byte and a word into a table and advances the table pointer by four. It stores the input word and a looked-up table entry into two record fields.

name: store_allocated_table_entry
description: Allocates a global table entry from the running counter when space remains and stores its value in a record field. It stores zero when the table is full.

name: store_table_word_into_record
description: Writes a byte and a word into a table, advances the table pointer by four, and stores the input word in a record field.

name: emit_ratio_record_with_table
description: Computes a signed ratio of a frame value by a structure field. When the ratio is zero it writes a five-word record with a fixed code, filling the remaining fields from table entries.

name: emit_ratio_record_direct_size
description: Divides a frame value by a register-supplied size. When the quotient is zero it writes a five-word record with a fixed code, filling the remaining fields from table entries.

name: emit_clipped_ratio_sprite_record
description: Computes a ratio when a flag bit is set and writes a six-word record if the position lies within limits of 320 and 168. The record code depends on that flag bit, and other fields come from table entries.

name: emit_fixed_five_word_record
description: Writes a five-word record with a fixed code and two values from another routine. It then stores a table entry in the second field.

name: emit_fixed_five_record_alt
description: Writes a five-word record with a fixed code, taking two values from another routine and a register. It stores a table entry in another field.

name: store_table_entry_record_offset
description: Allocates a global table entry from the running counter when space remains and stores it in a record field. It stores zero when the table is full.

name: store_table_word_record_field
description: Writes a byte and a word into a table and advances the table pointer by four. It then stores the input word in a record field.

name: build_transformed_vertex_entries
description: Selects a group of frame values by index and negates them when a flag bit is set. It writes them into a frame buffer at an index-derived offset and combines a table value with a frame value by exclusive-or.

name: rotate_vector_pair_by_index
description: Decodes a word from the input structure by rotating it or fetching it from frame storage. It then uses sine-like and cosine-like table values to rotate a pair of frame vectors.

name: rotate_frame_vector_pair_fixed
description: Fetches a frame entry by index, uses sine-like and cosine-like table values to rotate a pair of frame vectors, and writes the results into a frame buffer.

name: rotate_frame_entry_pair_store
description: Looks up a frame entry by index, derives sine-like and cosine-like table values, and writes rotated components of two frame vectors into the output buffer.

name: rotate_vectors_from_table_base
description: Uses sine-like and cosine-like values read from a table at a base address to rotate two frame vectors in place. Each doubled and shifted result is written back to the frame.

name: rotate_frame_vectors_direct_coefficient
description: Rotates two frame vectors in place using one table value and one register coefficient. The doubled and shifted results are stored back to the frame.

name: stub_return_constant_byte
description: Sets a global result to a fixed byte value and returns, with no other work.

name: stub_decompiler_timeout
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is unrecovered. The known facts show only that it is called by two routines and calls two others.

name: call_routine_thrice_with_offsets
description: Derives two offsets from a structure, optionally shifts three frame values by a count, and then calls another routine three times. Each call uses a temporary stack buffer.

name: call_routine_thrice_with_input
description: Takes an input value, optionally shifts three frame values by a count, and calls another routine three times using a temporary stack buffer.

name: dispatch_through_nested_table
description: Looks up a routine address through two chained tables indexed by a 16-bit input, calls that routine, and returns.

name: expand_encoded_string_stream
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination until a zero terminator. Control codes at the top of the byte range are expanded: code 255 calls another routine, code 254 emits a two-byte code, and the others emit a one-byte code.

name: expand_string_from_table_entry
description: Finds a source string through a table entry selected by a 15-bit input, then copies it with the same control-code expansion. Code 255 calls another routine.

name: expand_string_relative_offset
description: Locates a source string by adding a 16-bit offset in an address register, then copies it with the same control-code expansion as its neighbours.

name: expand_string_in_place
description: Expands control codes in a buffer by working backward from the write pointer. Code 255 calls another routine, and the other codes write two-byte or one-byte replacements before copying the remaining text.

name: expand_control_code_with_byte
description: Handles one control byte from a register by writing a two- or three-byte code sequence. It then copies text up to a zero terminator and repeats while the next byte is a control code.

name: expand_control_codes_forward
description: Writes a one-byte code and copies the following text, expanding further control codes as it reads them. Code 255 calls another routine and code 254 writes a three-byte sequence.

name: call_then_expand_text_stream
description: Calls another routine to obtain a pointer, skips two source bytes, and copies text while expanding control codes. Code 255 calls another routine and ends the loop.

name: dispatch_via_structure_table
description: Reads a routine address from a table at an offset computed from a 16-bit input, then calls it through the table's indirect pointer and returns.

name: wrap_text_at_width_limit
description: Scans a byte string, summing character widths from a table. When a line exceeds the width limit it replaces the last space before that point with a carriage return, and it stops if the text would move before the start.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: reset_frame_state_fields_flagged
description: Clears several frame state fields to zero and sets a sentinel value. It then calls other routines according to a flag in the structure.

name: reset_frame_state_fields_alt
description: Sets a frame state byte to a fixed non-zero value and clears related fields and a sentinel. It then calls other routines according to a flag in the structure.

name: scan_flagged_entries_loop
description: Walks a table of bytes backward from a starting index, stopping at the first entry with a particular flag bit set. It calls other routines to set up state before the scan.

name: find_flagged_entry_pair
description: Repeatedly calls another routine and scans backward through a flag table for an entry with a particular bit set. It returns a combined state word at the end.

name: test_vector_against_candidates
description: Computes the squared magnitude of a fixed-point vector from three components and compares it with a stored value. It walks candidate entries in a linked structure and records flags and a value in the frame state.

name: test_vector_magnitude_bound
description: Computes the squared magnitude of a fixed-point vector from its components and compares it with a stored bound. When the test passes it records a flag and a value in the frame state and returns the flag byte.

name: test_offset_vector_magnitude
description: Computes the squared magnitude of a fixed-point vector built from five parameters and compares it with a stored bound. When the test passes it records flags and a value in the frame state and returns the flag byte.

name: copy_rearrange_fixed_point_components
description: Stores fixed-point components into a structure and frame, calls other routines three times, and compares a value derived from two table-based offsets against a shifted quantity. The comparison updates the state.

name: divide_fixed_point_restoring
description: Performs a restoring fixed-point division in a loop, subtracting a shifted divisor until the remainder settles. The shifted quotient is stored in a frame state field.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no other work.

name: iterate_candidate_list_records
description: Walks a candidate list in a structure, repeatedly calling another routine and recording the chosen entry, its flags and a looked-up table value into the frame state.

name: damp_and_negate_structure_terms
description: Halves three 32-bit fields in a structure and negates each one. It calls another routine when a 16-bit field exceeds sixteen, then returns a frame state byte.

name: accumulate_weighted_table_terms
description: Iterates over a table of index and sign pairs, multiplying each selected structure coefficient by a 16-bit table value and accumulating the products. It stops at a zero entry and returns a frame state byte.

name: return_frame_state_flag
description: Returns the frame state byte stored at a fixed offset, without other work.

name: interpret_stream_commands_a
description: Reads command bytes from an input stream through several pointers and combines decoded values with register inputs. It calls one other routine and returns a 64-bit result.

name: interpret_stream_commands_b
description: Reads command bytes from a stream and updates several word fields using a table and register inputs. It returns a 64-bit value.

name: process_stream_command_common
description: Reads command bytes from a stream and updates word and table values. It calls three other routines as it handles each command and returns a 64-bit value.

name: decode_flagged_stream_bytes
description: Reads bytes from a stream while a high-bit flag is set, combining them with register state. It returns a 64-bit value.

name: test_bit_then_decode_stream
description: Tests one bit of a register against a shift count and, when it is set, decodes bytes from a stream. It stores flag values in a structure and calls four other routines.

name: return_fixed_wide_constant
description: Returns the constant 4294967296 with no other work.

name: scan_stream_until_zero
description: Reads bytes from a stream until a zero byte, calling other routines for each entry. It then stores a state byte in the frame.

name: process_stream_entries_until_end
description: Reads entries from a stream and calls other routines for each one, stopping at a zero terminator. It returns a 64-bit value.

name: emit_stream_entry_flagged
description: Reads a command byte and, when a flag bit is clear, calls another routine to derive a value. It stores the low byte of that value in a structure field and loops over the stream.

name: decode_stream_with_state_flags
description: Stores a masked command value in a frame state byte, then reads and decodes stream bytes in a loop with several calls. It returns a 64-bit result.

name: update_table_entries_from_stream
description: Combines 16-bit register values, table lookups and frame words to compute several values. It writes them into a structure and returns a 64-bit result.

name: decode_table_driven_fields
description: Looks up two table entries by indices taken from a register and multiplies them with register values. It also reads stream bytes and returns a 64-bit result.

name: lookup_table_scaled_stream_fields
description: Looks up table entries indexed by bits of a register and combines them with register inputs. It decodes stream bytes and returns a 64-bit value.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: stub_no_executable_code
description: Contains no executable instructions beyond a return, so there is no behaviour to recover.

name: swap_and_negate_matrix_words
description: Swaps the second and third words of each three-word group in a nine-word block and negates the words at positions zero, three and six. It operates in place on a 3x3 matrix in memory.

name: rearrange_matrix_words_block
description: Moves words between positions within a nine-word block, leaving the entries at positions zero, four and eight unchanged. It operates in place on a 3x3 matrix in memory.

name: normalize_and_multiply_structure
description: Normalizes six components held in a structure by shifting them right until they fit, then multiplies the result by a 3x3 matrix in memory. The shifted products are stored back into the structure.

name: shift_and_multiply_register_inputs
description: Shifts three register inputs right by a count, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory, and stores the shifted results into the structure.

name: apply_3x3_matrix_to_triplet
description: Applies a 3x3 matrix multiplication to three fixed-point values from registers and memory. The shifted results are written back to the structure.

name: normalize_components_by_matrix
description: Normalizes three structure components by a shift count, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory, and stores the shifted results in the structure.

name: multiply_shifted_inputs_by_matrix
description: Shifts register inputs right by a count and multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory. It stores the results as three 32-bit values in the structure.

name: scale_and_store_shifted_values
description: Shifts register values right by a count and stores them in the structure. It then computes further scaled components and stores those as well.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: search_sorted_node_list
description: Walks a sorted linked list of nodes stored in a structure, comparing 16-bit keys with an input. It stops at the first node whose key is not lower and checks a flag byte on the matching node.

name: insert_sorted_node_entry
description: Inserts a 16-bit key into a sorted linked list in a structure by moving existing nodes. It takes a new 12-byte node from a free pointer and updates the links.

name: allocate_list_node_at
description: Takes a new 12-byte node from a free pointer, stores a key and two fields in it, and links it after a given node. It then marks the node's flag byte.

name: link_new_list_node
description: Advances the free pointer to allocate a 12-byte node when a flag is clear, links it into the list, and writes key and value fields into the chosen node.

name: advance_sorted_list_position
description: Walks a sorted list of nodes from a starting position and returns once it reaches a node whose key is not lower than the input. It updates a flag word on matching nodes along the way.

name: update_node_key_and_payload
description: Stores a 16-bit key in a node and writes three 16-bit payload words after it. The node index is chosen according to a flag.

name: allocate_node_with_flag
description: Allocates a 12-byte node from the free pointer when a flag is clear and copies its links. It stores a key, then sets a status byte and payload words in the target node.

name: find_sorted_list_position
description: Searches a sorted linked list for the position of a 16-bit key, following next links until it finds a node with a larger key. It returns that node's index.

name: traverse_list_until_key
description: Follows next pointers through a list until it reaches a node whose key is not lower than the input. It then sets that node's status byte and resets its link to the constant twelve.

name: scan_list_range_flags
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, checking each node's flag bits and keys against two 16-bit bounds. It stops at the matching node.

name: insert_node_in_range
description: Walks a sorted node list to find where a 16-bit key belongs. It inserts a node from the free pointer when the key is not already present.

name: insert_node_if_key_differs
description: When the target node's key differs from a 16-bit input, allocates a new node from the free pointer. It copies the links and stores the key in the new node.

name: reset_free_list_nodes
description: Allocates a 12-byte node from the free pointer when a flag is clear and links it in. It then walks the list and sets each flagged node's status word to a fixed value.

name: scale_structure_components_matrix
description: Computes products of structure components and register values, shifting the results. It stores the products back into the structure.

name: transform_components_by_matrix_frame
description: Derives a shift count from a 16-bit input, shifts fixed-point components, and multiplies them with a 3x3 matrix in memory. The results are stored in a frame record.

name: store_six_shifted_register_values
description: Stores six shifted register values into consecutive frame slots, with sign words for three of them.

name: transform_components_by_matrix_b
description: Shifts components by a count and combines them with a 3x3 matrix in memory. The results are stored in a frame record and a second structure.

name: transform_components_by_matrix_c
description: Shifts components by a count and combines them with a 3x3 matrix in memory. The results are stored in a frame record.

name: store_six_shifted_values_offset
description: Stores six shifted values into frame slots at fixed offsets, with sign words for three of them.

name: compute_scaled_component_products
description: Computes scaled component products from structure and register inputs, shifting the results and storing them back into the structure.

name: normalize_three_components_shift
description: Shifts three input values right by a count derived from their magnitude and multiplies them with a matrix. The results are stored in an output structure.

name: return_shifted_pair_value
description: Shifts two register values right by a count and returns them packed into one 64-bit value.

name: initialise_pair_frame_record
description: Initialises a frame record with a status byte, 16-bit and 32-bit fields copied from the structure, and a table-selected entry. It then loops over linked entries until a sentinel value is reached.

name: store_pair_frame_fields
description: Stores the input fields into the frame record and selects an entry through a table. It then branches on a flag in the structure.

name: copy_pair_state_and_walk
description: Copies six register values into frame slots and marks a status word. It then walks linked entries, comparing their flag bytes.

name: evaluate_pair_flags_record
description: Calls another routine, stores three 16-bit results in the frame, and branches on flag bits to decide whether to call further routines.

name: evaluate_pair_flags_record_b
description: Stores three 16-bit results in the frame after a call to another routine, then branches on flag bits to choose which further routines to call.

name: evaluate_pair_flags_common
description: Handles a flag-driven branch between two linked entries, storing 16-bit results in the frame and calling other routines according to the flags.

name: compare_entry_types_update_state
description: Compares type bytes of two linked entries and, depending on the result, calls another routine with offsets from the frame. It then updates a status byte.

name: evaluate_pair_status_bits
description: Tests status bits of a frame record and two linked entries, then sets or clears a status byte. It calls other routines to compute and store 16-bit results in the frame.

name: evaluate_pair_status_reset
description: Clears or sets a status byte in the frame depending on a structure flag. It then runs the same status-bit tests and stores 16-bit results from other routines.

name: evaluate_pair_status_stored
description: Clears a status byte, runs status-bit tests with a sentinel check, and stores 16-bit results from other routines in the frame.

name: apply_pair_offsets_by_type
description: Compares type bytes of two linked entries. Depending on the result it calls another routine with coordinate differences from the frame, then updates a status byte.

name: evaluate_pair_status_flagged
description: Clears a status byte, then performs status-bit tests and calls other routines to store 16-bit results in the frame.

name: apply_pair_zero_call
description: Calls another routine with zero arguments when a structure flag is set, then runs the status-bit tests and stores results in the frame.

name: evaluate_pair_status_tail
description: Runs status-bit tests over linked entries and stores 16-bit results from other routines in the frame record.

name: apply_pair_negated_offsets
description: Compares type bytes and, when the flag bits match, calls another routine with negated coordinate values from one entry. It then runs the status-bit tests.

name: evaluate_pair_status_loop
description: Clears a status byte and runs status-bit tests through a loop of linked entries. It calls other routines for each candidate.

name: evaluate_pair_status_simple
description: Clears a status byte, calls another routine, and runs the status-bit tests over linked entries.

name: store_pair_results_from_calls
description: Runs status-bit tests and stores 16-bit results from several calls into the frame record.

name: store_pair_result_words
description: Stores three 16-bit results from calls and a register into the frame. It also writes 32-bit sums when a flag bit is set.

name: return_halved_global_pair
description: Calls another routine, halves a value, and returns a 64-bit result combining it with a second value.

name: store_pair_results_alt
description: Stores three 16-bit results into the frame when flags are set, and calls other routines for the remaining fields.

name: transform_3d_vector_pair
description: Performs a 3D vector transformation step, storing three 16-bit components in the frame. It also stores 32-bit sums when a flag bit is set.
